purpose: Group server-backed filter controls and make every active filter visible and individually removable.

removeFilter.description: Requests removal of one controlled filter.

clearAll.description: Requests one controlled reset of all active filters.

accessibility.keyboard: Controls, individual remove actions and clear-all are native keyboard targets.
accessibility.focus: No automatic focus movement occurs when results refresh.
accessibility.screenReader: Active-filter count, result summary and pending state are announced politely.

invariants: Visible filter labels are user-facing values rather than raw backend codes.
Filtering remains controlled by the owning screen and does not hide records only in browser memory.
A pending refresh disables destructive filter removal without hiding the current summary.
